app.title: Loupe
folder.label: Store folder
folder.none: Open a store folder to browse its objects. Loupe opens it read-only and holds its lock, so no instance can open it at the same time.
asOf.label: As of
asOf.placeholder: A tid, or empty for the last transaction
asOf.latest: The window shows the last transaction.
asOf.shown: The window shows the store as of {tid}.
asOf.noRoot: The store has no root object as of {tid}.
tree.label: Objects
history.title: History
history.failed: The window could not read the history. The error shows above.
diff.title: Changes from {from} to {to}
diff.failed: The window could not compare the two revisions. The error shows above.
diff.none: No change: the decoded states are equal.
diff.hidden: The values differ in a part that the state does not show.
diff.partial: The value is large. The view shows its start.
diff.limit: The view shows the first {shown} of {count} changes.
state.partial: The state is large. The window shows its start.
error.locked: Another process holds the lock of this store. Stop the instance that uses it, then open the folder again.
error.notClosedCleanly: This store was not closed cleanly. Open it once with a writer, such as a ZOE instance; the writer rebuilds the database's free-space map. Then open it in Loupe.
error.noRecordAsOf: Oid {oid} has no record as of {tid}.
error.refused: zoe-pickle refuses the record of oid {oid}: {message}
error.badId: {text} is not an oid or a tid in ZODB form, such as 0x00.
